Hi @nina, regarding STOCKFLOW-114: The design review decision for allocate_backorders was that backorders ship complete - an order is allocated all of its lines in full or nothing at all. If an order doesn't fit, it gets 0 on every line and leaves stock untouched, allowing smaller orders further down to still be filled.

Good catch. The half-up rule is the requirement, so `test_regression_issue_77` is the stale one — it predates the migration. File an issue to qa-team per the channel heads-up and we'll get it re-reviewed. Don't just ignore it.

Hey @lina, I found the note in my handover files. It says: Pickers walk the aisles in a serpentine (S-shaped) path: up the odd-numbered aisles and back down the even-numbered ones. Shelves are therefore visited in ascending order in odd aisles and in DESCENDING order in even aisles. Levels within a shelf are always ascending.
